positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Full Stack software engineer intern for TurboTax, a consumer tax preparation and e-filing software
•	Developed beacons in TurboTax to generate click stream for customer behavior analytics
•	Wrote unit tests for backend services and improved line coverage of the package by 20%
•	Developed UI automation testing scripts for a new feature in TurboTax web application 
•	Resolved bugs in TurboTax web application and improved quality of the product 

Technologies used: JavaScript, JQuery, HTML5, CSS, Jenkins, Selenium, Mockito

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed cross browser extensions to share web article to a mobile application
•	Wrote RESTful web service leveraged by web and mobile devices to import contacts from Facebook and Google 
•	Developed and integrated a REST API in data pipeline for data cleanup and storage 
•	Performed manual testing of the mobile application and managed bug reporting 


Technologies used: Java, JavaScript, JQuery, AJAX, Jersey, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:

• Designed a relational database for the user and commerce data

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked as a Core Committee member for Youth Red Cross, an initiative taken by group of students to provide social service and bring a change to the society. projects.title: Real-time Streaming System using Apache Spark
projects.description:
•  Developed a client application to simulate temperature sensor data to Kafka broker 
•  Setup and deployed Apache Spark locally 
•  Wrote Kafka consumer in Apache Spark for real time data processing and analytics
•  Distributed data streams to four clusters to filter the data and display it using Highcharts

projects.title: Internet of Things (IoT) Client Server Framework Development
projects.description:
• Developed a client server framework using OMA Lightweight M2M protocol for IoT devices
• Developed REST services supporting JSON for remote thermostat management 
 
  
Tools and technology used: Java, Jersey, REST, Amazon AWS, JavaScript, HTML, MongoDB
